events.label: Binance plans to resume withdrawals after covering up to 90% of the ~$6.3 billion stolen from its hot wallets
events.note: First test of whether users pull funds once they can; bitcoin's $76,176 Friday low is the level.

events.label: US midterm elections — Trump's pledged $5,000 per-adult 'dividend' is contingent on Republicans holding both chambers
events.note: Pointed at about $154.5B of tariff revenue in the first ten months of FY2026; even 100 million recipients would cost $500B. The House is currently projected to go to the Democrats, so it is a tail input — but it lands on a long end that spent September repricing term premium.

events.label: Treasury expanded long-end buyback program ends — ops of at least $4B run from September 9
events.note: The count of completed operations is what separates absorbed supply from purchased calm at the long end. Updated Sep 10 night: the 30Y cleared 5.33%, August 18's prior high, and closed at 5.37% — its highest since 2007 — while the program was buying that maturity. The 2007 peak is 5.44%. Updated Sep 23 night: the thirty-year closed at 5.40%, the highest close since 2004 and four basis points under the 5.44% 2007 peak, while the program is still bidding that maturity — the buyback is now the clearest read on whether the long end is absorbing supply or being held.

events.label: China's suspension of rare-earth export controls expires on its original date — the tariff truce itself was extended to January 10 (Bessent, Sep 23)
events.note: The trade deadline moved out of the quarter; whether the rare-earth suspension moves with it is the open question for the chip supply chain

events.label: MSCI publishes final list of 'non-operating companies' to be excluded under new index rules; effective after the November 30 close
events.note: Strategy fell nearly 10% on October 16 on the rule change while bitcoin was little changed.

events.label: Anthropic IPO (approx.) — S-1 filed Oct 26 for a Nasdaq listing as ANT; price range and share count not yet set
events.note: Listing could come as soon as mid-November; the price range will set the first public value of a frontier AI lab and test demand for AI equity.

events.label: Grand Theft Auto VI release date — the scheduled window Take-Two's 17% 2026 decline is pricing scepticism about
events.note: Added Sep 17 morning: Take-Two held its annual shareholder meeting on Sep 17 with the title still scheduled for Nov 19 after repeated delays. The stock is down 17% in 2026, so the market is discounting the date rather than the title. A reaffirmation or a further slip is what revalues it, and the release lands sixteen days after the midterms and three weeks before the December FOMC.

events.label: Spain snap general election — called October 5 by Pedro Sánchez after parliament rejected his housing measures
events.note: Second euro-area political risk alongside France's 2027 budget; the euro hit a 17-month low the day it was called.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — terminal insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut. Lock-up expiries are the known supply overhang for hot IPOs. Context after Aug 6-7: 20% first tranche absorbed at $105-$115; next tranches scheduled Aug 20 and late September. Q3 Starlink profitability (~October call) is the only fundamental catalyst that could revalue the lockup discount before the December terminal release. SPCX Q2: $18.37B capex vs $7.81B revenue; AI segment $2.56B (+247% YoY).

events.label: End of the 60-day review of Trump's Russia sanctions waiver (approx., order dated October 18)
events.note: The waiver that took Brent off $110 can be revisited by this date.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). PLTR's 149% US commercial growth, AMD's $6.7B data-center (+107%), and SpaceX's exclusive Nvidia commitment ($15.83B AI capex) confirm the enterprise AI adoption underlying OpenAI's revenue model. NVDA circular financing disclosure ($250B OpenAI backstop) remains the unresolved structural question that may surface in S-1 filings.

events.label: Extended US-China 'Busan' trade truce expires — Bessent says a larger package or another roll-over are both possible
events.note: Replaces the November deadline as the date the China policy track resolves

events.label: Meta non-voting Class C stock takes effect — one Class C share issued per Class A/B share, a new tool to fund AI spending
events.note: Approved with Q3 results while free cash flow was negative; shows how Meta intends to fund its buildout.
